exposure: Fetal head station at the diagnosis of the second stage of labor
cohort: 34,334 women who had singleton vertex deliveries at a single tertiary center between 2011 and 2016.
finding: Fetal head station at the first diagnosis of the second stage of labor was significantly and independently associated with the duration of the second stage and correlated with the risk of operative delivery in both nulliparous and multiparous women.
